scholarships.title: Nanyang Global Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Full Tuition Fee Coverage + Living and Accommodation Allowances
scholarships.official_source: Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Office of Admissions

existing.description: The Nanyang Global Scholarship is awarded by Nanyang Technological University to outstanding freshmen pursuing undergraduate programmes, recognising students with outstanding academic results, strong leadership abilities and very good co-curricular records. It is open to all nationalities and covers the years of study at NTU for successful awardees reading a full-time undergraduate degree programme. Benefits include full coverage of subsidised tuition fees after the Tuition Grant, a living allowance of S$6,500 per academic year, an accommodation allowance of up to S$2,000 per academic year for NTU hostel residents, a travel grant of up to S$8,000 for an overseas programme for new cohorts from AY2025, a one-off computer allowance of S$2,000, and enrolment into NTU Honours College. The scholarship holder must maintain a minimum CGPA of 3.5 over 5.0, reviewed every semester, and serve as a student ambassador when required.
eligibility: Awardees should read a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU; the scholarship will cover the years of study at NTU

Possess outstanding academic achievements in the Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, Diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Applicants must read a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU and hold outstanding academic achievements in the Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, a Diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications, together with an excellent co-curricular record and strong leadership qualities and potential.
benefits: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant)
Living allowance of S$6,500 per academic year
Accommodation allowance of up to S$2,000 per academic year (applicable to scholarship holders who reside in NTU hostels only)
Travel grant of up to S$8,000 for an overseas programme, subject to terms and conditions in the Travel Grant Form (for new cohorts from AY2025)
Enrolment into NTU's flagship undergraduate college, NTU Honours College
coverage: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant)
Living allowance of S$6,500 per academic year
Accommodation allowance of up to S$2,000 per academic year (NTU hostel residents only)
Travel grant of up to S$8,000 for an overseas programme (for new cohorts from AY2025), subject to the terms and conditions in the Travel Grant Form
Enrolment into NTU's flagship undergraduate college, NTU Honours College
requirements: Submit an application for admission before submitting an application for the scholarship
Maintain a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 3.5 over 5.0, reviewed every semester
Hold no other scholarship, bursary, university loan or award without University approval
Take on the role of student ambassador or any other similar role representing the university when called upon
documents: Completed NTU scholarship application form accessed with the NTU application number
Personal Essay of not more than 250 words answering 1 compulsory topic
Online referee's appraisal completed by a school teacher who is not a family member or relative, submitted within 7 days of the scholarship application
application_method: Submit the NTU admission application first and receive an NTU application number
Access the scholarship application form via the 'Apply for Scholarship' link at the end of the online admission application, or via the reserved-programme login link
For Year 12 equivalent results, apply through the separate international applicant scholarship login before the admission application closing date for that qualification
Have a school teacher complete the online referee's appraisal within 7 days using the URL provided after the scholarship application
existing.selection_notes: Scholarship selection interviews will take place between March and May. Only scholarship applicants shortlisted for an interview will be informed via e-mail by mid-May. Applicants offered either the Medicine programme or the Renaissance Engineering Programme are to check with the school for the outcome of their scholarship application. For applicants with Year 12 equivalent qualifications, selection interviews take place within 2 months from the date the NTU programme offer is released.
existing.best_fit: Outstanding school-leavers of any nationality with strong A-level, polytechnic, IB or Year 12 equivalent results, an excellent co-curricular record and demonstrated leadership, applying to a full-time NTU undergraduate programme and willing to meet the CGPA and ambassador-role conditions.
existing.notes: The official page states: "No bond is attached to the Nanyang Global Scholarship apart from the three-year bond applicable to all Singapore PRs and international students under the MOE Tuition Grant Scheme." The stored record's current_image_source_url points at a different NTU award (the NBS Global Leaders Programme Scholarship) and is not evidence for this scholarship.
existing.duration: The scholarship covers up to the normal programme duration on condition that the scholarship holder maintains a record of good academic performance and exemplary conduct.
existing.application_period: The scholarship application period matches the NTU admission application period for the applicant's qualification. For AY2027/2028 the earliest published window opens on 15 October 2026, so no window is open as at 2026-10-04. Scholarship selection interviews take place between March and May, and shortlisted applicants are informed by e-mail by mid-May.
existing.deadline_display: The official page states: "The scholarship application period is the same as the admission application period." The NTU 'Important dates' page publishes the AY2027/2028 windows as "15 October 2026 - 19 March 2027" for International Baccalaureate (Application for Scholarships, online application: "by 19 March 2027"; submission of photograph and appraisal form: "by 26 March 2027"), "1 December 2026 - 20 January 2027" for NUS High School Diploma (scholarship online application: "by 20 January 2027"; photograph and appraisal form: "by 27 January 2027"), and "15 Oct 2026 - 20 Jan 2027" or "15 Oct 2026 - 19 Mar 2027" for other international and equivalent qualifications.

scholarships.title: Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Full Tuition Fee + Monthly Stipend + Allowances

existing.description: The Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship (NPGS) is a competitive and prestigious scholarship scheme offered by Nanyang Technological University to encourage outstanding graduates or final-year students to take their first step towards a leading research career by studying full-time for a PhD at NTU. It is described as the premier scholarship granted by NTU's President, recognising PhD students who exemplify exceptional academic, research and leadership qualities. Open to all nationalities, it requires an Honours (Highest Distinction) or equivalent at Bachelor's level, or official documentation confirming the candidate is on track to achieve it. Monthly stipends revised with effect from January 2026 are S$5,300 for Singapore Citizens, S$4,800 for Singapore Permanent Residents and S$4,300 for international students, with CPF contributions on top for Citizens. The award also covers the annual tuition fee and provides an overseas conference allowance of up to S$5,000 per financial year, an annual book allowance of S$500, a one-off IT allowance of S$1,500, a one-off thesis allowance of S$600 and priority for campus accommodation. There is no bond attached to the scholarship, though international students must perform teaching or laboratory supervision duties under the Graduate Assistantship Programme.
eligibility: All nationalities are eligible for the scholarship
An Honours (Highest Distinction) or equivalent at Bachelor's level

Candidates who have not yet completed their undergraduate degree must provide official documentation from their university confirming they are on track to graduate with an Honours (Highest Distinction) degree or equivalent
Must be an outstanding graduate or final-year student taking the first step towards a leading research career by studying full-time for a PhD at NTU
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Applicants must be outstanding graduates or final-year students taking their first step towards a leading research career by studying full-time for a PhD at NTU, and must hold an Honours (Highest Distinction) or equivalent at Bachelor's level. Candidates who have not yet completed their undergraduate degree must provide official documentation from their university confirming they are on track to graduate with an Honours (Highest Distinction) degree or equivalent.
benefits: Monthly stipend: S$4,300 (International Student), S$4,800 (Singapore Permanent Resident), S$5,300 (Singapore Citizen), revised with effect from January 2026
Coverage of the annual tuition fee
CPF contributions at the prevailing employer's contribution rate on top of the stipend for Singapore Citizens
Overseas Conference Allowance of up to S$5,000 per financial year (April previous year to March current year), revised with effect from April 2026
Book Allowance: annual grant of S$500
IT Allowance: one-time allowance of S$1,500
Thesis Allowance: one-time allowance of S$600, disbursed during the final year scholarship renewal
coverage: Monthly stipend (S$4,300 international, S$4,800 Singapore Permanent Resident, S$5,300 Singapore Citizen, revised with effect from January 2026)
CPF contributions on top of the stipend for Singapore Citizens
Overseas conference allowance of up to S$5,000 per financial year (April previous year to March current year), revised with effect from April 2026
Book allowance: annual grant of S$500
IT allowance: one-time allowance of S$1,500

requirements: Study full-time for a PhD at NTU
Observe the terms and conditions for the award of the Scholarship

documents: Official documentation from the awarding university confirming the applicant is on track to graduate with an Honours (Highest Distinction) degree or equivalent, if the undergraduate degree is not yet complete
PhD admission application documents required by NTU
application_method: Apply for PhD admission at NTU in the normal way
The application period for each Academic Year is announced by NTU in due course
Successful candidates are informed of the outcome together with the offer of admissions via email
existing.selection_notes: The NPGS is described by NTU as 'a competitive and prestigious scholarship scheme' and 'The premier scholarship granted by NTU's President, recognizing PhD students who exemplify exceptional academic, research and leadership qualities.' Successful candidates must observe the terms and conditions for the award of the Scholarship.
existing.best_fit: Outstanding Bachelor's graduates or final-year students with an Honours (Highest Distinction) degree or equivalent, of any nationality, intending to study full-time for a PhD at NTU and able to take on Graduate Assistantship Programme teaching or laboratory supervision duties.
existing.notes: Stipend figures shown are the international-student rate because this row targets international applicants. The official page notes that the stipend 'remains the same for existing students receiving higher stipend rates', so the January 2026 rates apply to new recipients. The official page also warns that 'Scholarship coverage and award terms are subject to change. The university reserves the right to vary the amount of the Award stipend at any time.' The stored record's official_source_url is a general NTU graduate scholarships index rather than this award's own page; per the merge rules the stored URL is preserved unchanged and the correct page is recorded in url_observed.
existing.duration: The award is tenable for one year in the first instance and is renewable subject to good progress. The maximum period of the Scholarship is 4 years for PhD candidates, as determined by school as well as availability of research funding in each case.
existing.application_period: The application period is announced by NTU in due course for each Academic Year. Successful candidates are informed of the outcome together with the offer of admissions via email.
existing.deadline_display: The official page states: "The application period for Academic Year 2027-2028 will be announced in due course. The application period for National Institute of Education (NIE) will also be announced in due course." No exact date is published for any cycle.
